name: Grayscaled Serenity
source:
Dylan Noir is a silent kid living in a two-bedroom apartment with his mom who has been mentally abusing Dylan ever since her divorce with her husband. While at school Dylan's been the subject of bullies due to his slim body and possibly gender preference. Because of these, he has become a cynical boy who hardly show any emotion.

Dylan probably has lost all reasons he could have to continue living.

Tired and hopeless, he decided to sleep. Forever.

But mysteriously, when he thought finally was over, he woke up in a place that is quiet, calm, and comforting and was greeted by a girl with. . . sparkles? There he met other people who share similar sentiments with him.

This is a story of finding one's true self, surviving obstacles, acceptance, and opening your heart to others.

[From [url=http://callmemkay.blogspot.com/p/visual-novels.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
迪伦·诺瓦是个沉默寡言的男孩，与母亲住在两居室公寓里。自从母亲与父亲离婚后，她便一直对迪伦进行精神虐待。在学校里，迪伦因为瘦弱的身材以及可能的性取向而成为霸凌对象。由于这些经历，他变成了一个几乎不流露情感的愤世嫉俗少年。

迪伦大概已经失去了继续活下去的所有理由。

疲惫而绝望的他决定长眠不醒。永远。

然而，当他以为一切终于结束时，却神秘地在一个安静、平和、令人安心的地方醒来，并遇见了一名浑身闪烁着……星光？的女孩。在那里，他遇见了其他抱有相似心情的人。

这是一个寻找真实自我、克服障碍、学会接纳并向他人敞开心扉的故事。

[来源：[url=http://callmemkay.blogspot.com/p/visual-novels.html]官方网站[/url]]
